rows.finding: Retail writes fixed hint header strings, traverses eight global linked lists with 255-record caps, emits fields at offsets +0x70/+0x60/+0x68/+0x64/+0x7C, and closes the shared handle. The host hook emits a shortened header, delegates records through a different list callback, and does not model the global write/error/critical-section path; text-format and ownership equivalence are not established.

Retail copies the six word header from the score object, serializes exactly seven CR sections at 0x437C-byte strides with the 0x5243 tag and 0xB3E-byte checksum loop, adds the 0x110-byte trailer checksum, compresses, encrypts with key 53/block 16, and writes scoreth10.dat. The host loops caller-supplied sections, computes only a flat payload sum, fabricates SCR0/version fields, and omits the fixed record/trailer layout.

LZSS control structure agrees: 0x2000 ring, 0x12-byte lookahead, literal flag bits, 13-bit position plus 5-bit (length-3) tokens, tree delete/insert per emitted byte, and final partial flag flush match IDA C 50773-51057, Ghidra 004359B0 lines 10-178, and asm sub_4359B0. Boundary: source makes retail globals, allocation, and output-capacity failure explicit through LzssState/output_capacity.

Match-tree insertion agrees on the 0x2000+byte roots, 18-byte compare, longest-match update, child-link insertion, and full-match node replacement. IDA C 51229-51324, Ghidra 00436000 lines 10-95, and asm sub_436000 match; source exposes the retail globals as LzssState and returns the match length rather than using the register ABI.
